user.title: Add Mitsubishi Climate Proxy
user.description: Create a hybrid entity with Dual/Single setpoint wrapper and optional vane control. Turn-on can restore the last active mode or use a fixed default. Coordinator mode follows the coordinator instead.

data.name: Name for the new Hybrid Entity
data.coordinator_single_target: Coordinator single-target mode (Tesla-style: one target temp, coordinator owns mode)
data.room_key: Coordinator room key (any zone key, e.g. 'primary') — required for single-target mode
data.comfort_offset: Comfort offset (°F) applied to the far band edge
data.restore_last_mode: Restore last active mode on turn-on
data.default_turn_on_mode: Default turn-on mode (fallback when no saved mode is supported)

data_description.default_turn_on_mode: Choose default to use the first supported mode: heat_cool, auto, heat, cool, dry, fan_only. A supported saved mode takes precedence when restoration is enabled.

init.title: Mitsubishi Climate Proxy options
init.description: Toggle the Tesla-style single-target surface for a coordinator-owned head. Changes reload the entry in place (HomeKit tile is preserved, no re-pair). Turn-on can restore the last active mode or use a fixed default. Coordinator mode follows the coordinator instead.

data.room_key: Coordinator room key (any zone key, e.g. 'primary')
data.restore_last_mode: Restore last active mode on turn-on
data.default_turn_on_mode: Default turn-on mode (fallback when no saved mode is supported)

data_description.default_turn_on_mode: Choose default to use the first supported mode: heat_cool, auto, heat, cool, dry, fan_only. A supported saved mode takes precedence when restoration is enabled.
